meta.title: CPS Test - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Test your clicking speed in 10 seconds. Find out how many clicks per second you can do.
cpsInstruction: Click as fast as possible for {duration} seconds. Click the area below to start.
steps_cps-test_1Desc: Position your hand comfortably on your mouse. The test measures how many times you can click in your chosen time window.
steps_cps-test_2Desc: Click anywhere in the test area as fast as you can. The timer counts down and your CPS (clicks per second) updates in real time.
steps_cps-test_3Desc: Your final CPS score displays with a performance rating. Compare to global averages. Repeat to improve — different clicking techniques yield different results.
desc: Test your clicking speed in 10 seconds. Find out how many clicks per second you can do.
